set.text: Our school sports day was on Tuesday. When we woke up, it was raining hard, so the teacher moved the games to Friday. I was a little sad because I practiced running for two weeks and wanted to race on Tuesday. But my friend Sara said, "If it is sunny on Friday, we can run even faster!" I felt better after that.

qs.q: Why did the teacher move the games?
o: Several students were sick that day.
It was raining hard that morning.
The games were not ready yet.
qs.why: 글에서 비가 많이 와서(raining hard, so ...) 선생님이 경기를 금요일로 옮겼다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why was the writer a little sad?
o: The writer lost a race against Sara last week.
The writer forgot about the sports day itself.
The writer had practiced running for two weeks.
The writer did not like the teacher very much.
qs.why: because 뒤에 이유가 나와요. 두 주 동안 달리기를 연습했는데 경기를 못 하게 되어 조금 슬펐어요.

qs.q: What does Sara say about Friday?
o: She wants to cancel all of the games.
She will be absent from school on that day.
She hopes to practice more at home first.
They can run even faster if it is sunny.
qs.why: Sara는 금요일에 날씨가 맑으면 더 빨리 달릴 수 있다고 했어요.

qs.q: How did the writer feel at the end?
o: The writer became angry at Sara for talking.
The writer felt better after Sara spoke.
The writer wanted to go home right away.
The writer decided to stop running for good.
qs.why: 마지막 문장에서 I felt better after that이라고 했어요.

qs.why: 글 전체가 할머니의 정원과 그곳에서 함께 보내는 시간에 대한 이야기예요.
because 뒤에 이유가 나와요. 흙이 너무 단단하기 때문이에요.

qs.q: 글쓴이는 여름에 할머니 댁에 가면 무엇을 하나요?
qs.why: 여름에 가면 할머니를 도와 식물에 물을 준다고 했어요.
토마토가 빨가면 따서 함께 샐러드를 만든다고 했어요.
